problems.msg: First Z move after the tool change on N20, but G43 H hasn't been called for this tool.
H04 is used with T3. Usually the H number matches the tool number.
This G01 move runs at feed rate, but no F has been set yet.
This G01 move cuts while the spindle is stopped (it was never started).
Start is 0.6 from the center but the end is 0.4 from it (off by 0.2).
X1 has no decimal point, so the control reads it as X0.0001 in. Write X1. if you mean 1 in.
Y appears twice on this line (Y2., Y3.). The control uses one of them or alarms.
G91 and G90 are both distance codes. Only one can be active, so the control alarms or uses the last one.
G41 has to start on a G00 or G01 move, not an arc.
G41 turns on cutter comp but no D offset has been given.
G83 (Peck drill) needs Q or I, J, K.
G81 (Drill) needs R: the retract plane.
G81 is still active at the tool change. Add G80 first.
This control allows 1 M-code per line, and this line has 2 (M08, M09).
M08 and M09 on the same line contradict each other.
G04 needs P or X for the dwell time.
G28 under G90 moves through work position Z0. on the way home. Use G28 G91 with Z0. instead.
G81 is still active at the program end. Add G80 first.

problems.msg: On Okuma, G54 is the X-axis tool length offset, not work offset 1. Select work offsets with G15 H1.
First Z move after the tool change on N20, but G56 H hasn't been called for this tool.
On Okuma mills G43 cancels the 3-D tool offset. Tool length offset is G56 H, cancelled by G53.
This G01 move runs at feed rate, but no F has been set yet.
This G01 move cuts while the spindle is stopped (it was never started).
Start is 0.6 from the center but the end is 0.4 from it (off by 0.2).

G41 has to start on a G00 or G01 move, not an arc.
G41 turns on cutter comp but no D offset has been given.
G83 (Peck drill) needs Q: the peck depth or shift.
Okuma mills set the cycle return level with M52, M53 or M54 (R level, the default), not G98.
G81 (Drill) needs R: the retract plane.
G81 is still active at the tool change. Add G80 first.
